notes.title: "Pretty Girls Breakout! PLUS" How to play!
notes.notes:
[h3][How to play][/h3]
The objective of the game is to control your ship to clear the destructible blocks and enemies by bouncing balls and enemy bullets with your bat.
[list]
[*]Pretty Battle
Swing your bat to bounce balls and clear the destructible blocks and enemies.
Destroy all the destructible blocks and enemies to clear the stage.
A life is lost when the ball falls past you or your ship is hit by an enemy's bullet.
If your life reaches 0 or you fail to clear the stage within the time limit, the game is over.
Points are earned by clearing stages, and can be exchanged for character costumes and other items at the Dressing Room Exchange.
[*]Eternal Challenge
In this mode, players compete to see how high they can improve their high score by continuously breaking blocks that come at them endlessly.
The score will increase as you break blocks or smash the ball continuously, but it will decrease if the ball falls or is damaged.
The game ends when the block reaches the position of your ship.
[/list]
[h3][Basic Rules][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42640372/d1d72cfd167c20e9d153af7cdf689e77c740c6e3.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Operate your ship and hit the ball toward the blocks to destroy them.
[*]If you drop the ball below your own ship with only one ball on the screen, or if the enemy's attack bullet hits your ship, you will "miss" and lose a LIFE.
[*]If you hit the ball back at the right time, it will become a smash and the power of the ball will increase. As the power of the ball increases, it becomes easier to break hard blocks.
[/list]
[h3][Hit Bonus][/h3]
Hit the ball with a swing at the right time to perform a “Smash”.
The ball is strengthened by doing it a certain number of times in a row.
When the ball is strengthened, the effect of penetration occurs and will continue to penetrate until you hit an indestructible object.
When a ball or bullet is bounced off a swing, the direction of reflection is the direction in which the bat is facing.
You can bounce the ball in the direction you are aiming by hitting it back at the right time and position.

[h3][Item][/h3]
Appears by chance when you break a block, and can be obtained when the item comes into contact with your ship.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42640372/52ca8ef0718e988f12f64bfdb96e5fd401d245ec.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]Wide Flipper
The size and swinging range of your ship will increase.
[*]Double Ball
Adds an extra ball.
[*]Barrier
The ball can be rebounded a certain number of times, preventing it from falling past your ship.
[*]Slow ball
The movement speed of all balls slows down for a certain period of time.
[*]Shot
Fires bullets from your ship for a certain period of time.
[*]Bomb
Shoot a bomb that destroys the surrounding blocks only once.
[*]Protection
prevents enemy bullets from hitting your ship for one time only.
[*]Big Ball
Increases the size of all balls for a certain period of time.
[/olist]
[h3][Block type][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42640372/e04a222687a90780b3771d060f1f2e3e6053a15a.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]Normal block
This is a normal block. It can be destroyed by hitting it with a ball or an enemy bullet.
[*]Wall block
This is a block that cannot be destroyed even if you hit it with a ball or an enemy bullet.
[*]Item block
This is a block where an item always appears when it is destroyed.
[*]Large block
This block is larger and more durable than the normal block. It can be broken by hitting it a certain number of times.
[*]Bat block
A block with a bar on it. The bar bounces back when it touched the bar. The angle of the bar changes at the same time as the ball bounces back. The block cannot be destroyed even if it is hit by a ball or a returned enemy projectile.
[*]Swing block
A block with a rotating bar on it. If a ball touches the bar, it will be repelled. This is a block that cannot be destroyed even if you hit it with a ball or an enemy bullet.
[*]Canon block
This is a turret block that fires enemy bullets at your ship. It is a block that cannot be destroyed even if you hit it with a ball or an enemy bullet.
[/olist]
[h3][Enemy][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42640372/2fc942cc10627bc7beaad1ed0abf875832a4f16c.png[/img]
Attacks by firing bullets at the player. If your ship is hit by an enemy projectile, it will count as a “miss” and you will lose a life. You can swing to bounce enemy bullets back upward, destroying blocks and damaging enemies.
